title: Delivery Hug Therapy
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Burnt-out 29-year-old Kiichi gets blackout drunk after his best friend's wedding and wakes to find 20-year-old university student and part-time bartender Nao looking after him. They agree to weekly 'therapeutic' hug sessions that slowly grow into a romance, as Kiichi comes to terms with his attraction to men and Nao with a hurtful past relationship.
life_message: Gentle, patient affection and honest acceptance of one's own feelings lead to healing and love.
